sections.h2: A locally owned painting company that does its own work
body: Precision Paint Experts is a locally owned painting company in North Central Florida, based in Newberry. We have more than 15 years of painting experience. We work for homeowners, businesses, property managers, HOAs, churches, and schools across Alachua, Marion, Levy, Columbia, and Gilchrist counties.
We don't subcontract. The crew lead who walks your property and writes the estimate is the person on site while the work gets done. You always know who to call.

sections.h2: What Florida weather teaches you about paint
body: Paint in this region has to work harder than it looks. Months of humidity, afternoon storms, strong sun on south- and west-facing walls, and heavy spring pollen all wear down a coating. Pick the wrong product or paint at the wrong time of day and you'll be repainting years too early.

That's why our product choices follow the surface. We use premium Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore lines: 100% acrylic on siding and trim, elastomeric on stucco with hairline movement, waterborne urethane enamel on cabinets, doors, and railings, and penetrating stains on bare wood. Summer exterior work starts early in the day, with an eye on dew point and radar. Our article on why humidity makes paint peel explains what happens when those steps get skipped.

Every job follows the same order. First, a walkthrough where we measure, photograph conditions, and take moisture readings. Then a written estimate that names every surface, prep step, product, and coat. Prep gets its own days on the schedule: washing, scraping, sanding, mildew treatment, setting nail pops, replacing rot and fascia, re-caulking, and spot-priming. After that comes at least two full coats, back-brushed or back-rolled where the coating needs to soak in.

The job ends with a punch walk that you sign. If something isn't right, we fix it before closing out. You also get labeled touch-up paint and a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years on exterior projects, on top of the manufacturer's product warranty.

We paint for homeowners and for businesses, and the approach is the same for both. For homeowners, it's residential painting inside and out, cabinet refinishing, deck and fence staining, and the repairs that come first. For businesses, it's offices, retail and restaurants, warehouses, churches and schools, multi-family buildings, and HOA communities, scheduled around their hours, including nights and weekends.

Staying in North Central Florida lets us know the buildings well, from older wood-frame homes to block-and-stucco houses and commercial buildings along the interstate. It also means the people who painted your house are close by if you ever need a warranty visit.
